script:
[serious] Ek simple sawaal se shuru karte hain. Kya insaan ki intelligence, uski ability, fix hoti hai janam se? Ya woh badal sakti hai?

[pause]

Carol Dweck, ek Stanford psychologist, ne yeh sawaal decades tak research kiya. Aur unka jawaab poori duniya ke liye ek wake-up call ban gaya. Unki book ka naam hai "Mindset". Aur iska core idea itna powerful hai ki yeh aapki zindagi ka pura trajectory badal sakta hai.

Aaj hum is book ke teen core ideas samjhenge. Fixed mindset kya hota hai. Growth mindset kaise kaam karta hai. Aur yeh dono roz-marra ki zindagi mein, aapke success aur failure ko kaise control karte hain.

[instructive] Chaliye shuru karte hain pehle idea se — Fixed Mindset.

Dweck kehti hain, kuch log believe karte hain ki intelligence, talent, ability — yeh sab fix hai. Jitna mila hai janam se, bas utna hi hai. Na kam ho sakta hai, na zyada.

Aisa insaan jab kisi challenge ka saamna karta hai, uske dimaag mein ek hi sawaal chalta hai — "Agar main fail ho gaya, toh log mujhe stupid samjhenge." Failure uske liye sirf ek result nahi hai. Failure uski identity ka judgement ban jaata hai.

[serious] Isliye fixed mindset wala insaan hamesha easy cheezein choose karta hai. Woh challenge se bachta hai. Kyunki agar challenge fail ho gaya, toh uska pura self-worth threat mein aa jaata hai.

Dweck ne apni research mein bachon ko puzzles diye. Kuch bachon ko fixed mindset ki taraf lean karte dekha gaya — jab unhe mushkil puzzle mila, unhone turant haar maan li. Unka reaction tha — "Main iske liye smart nahi hoon."

[pause]

Yeh sirf bachon ki baat nahi hai. Yeh humare office mein hai. Humare relationships mein hai. Jab hum kisi naye skill ko try karne se darte hain, kyunki humein lagta hai — "Agar main achha nahi kar paaya, toh mera talent hi nahi hai" — tab hum fixed mindset mein jee rahe hote hain.

[reflective] Sochiye — kitni baar aapne kuch naya start karne se pehle hi soch liya, "Yeh mujhse nahi hoga." Bina try kiye. Bas isliye, kyunki aapko lagta hai ki ya toh aap iss cheez mein "naturally good" hain, ya bilkul nahi hain.

Yeh belief hi hai jo humein limit karta hai. Aur yahi Dweck ka sabse bada point hai — problem talent ki nahi hai. Problem us belief ki hai jo hum talent ke baare mein rakhte hain.

[instructive] Ab dusra idea samajhte hain — Growth Mindset.

Growth mindset wale log believe karte hain ki ability ek starting point hai, end point nahi. Intelligence, skill, talent — yeh sab develop kiya ja sakta hai. Effort se, strategy se, aur dusron se seekh kar.

[measured] Aur is belief ka effect sirf motivation tak limited nahi hai. Yeh puri tarah se badal deta hai ki insaan challenges ko kaise dekhta hai.

Growth mindset wala insaan jab kisi mushkil task ka saamna karta hai, uske dimaag mein sawaal hota hai — "Main isse kya seekh sakta hoon?" Failure use hurt toh karta hai, lekin woh usse identity ka sawaal nahi banata. Woh usse ek data point banata hai — feedback, jo agla step better banane mein madad karega.

[pause]

Dweck ne ek fascinating study kiya tha high school students par. Jin students ko sikhaya gaya ki brain ek muscle ki tarah hai — jise train kiya ja sakta hai, jo practice se strong hota hai — unke grades mein significant improvement dekha gaya. Sirf ek belief change karne se.

[serious] Yeh line dobara suniye — sirf ek belief change karne se performance badal gayi.

Yehi is book ka sabse deep insight hai. Aapki ability aapke performance ko determine nahi karti. Aapki belief about ability, woh determine karti hai.

[reflective] Growth mindset wale log mistakes se darte nahi. Woh mistakes ko dushman nahi maante — woh unhe teacher maante hain.

Socho, Thomas Edison ne bulb banane se pehle hazaar baar fail kiya tha. Usne kaha tha — "Maine fail nahi kiya, maine hazaar tareeke dhoondh liye jo kaam nahi karte." Yeh pure growth mindset ki soch hai.

[instructive] Ab teesra idea — yeh mindsets sirf abstract theory nahi hain. Yeh humari daily zindagi ke har area mein dikhte hain — sports mein, business mein, relationships mein.

Dweck ne sports champions ka example diya hai. Michael Jordan school team se reject kiya gaya tha. Fixed mindset wala insaan wahin ruk jaata — "Main achha nahi hoon, basketball mera cup of tea nahi hai." Lekin Jordan ne rejection ko fuel banaya. Usne practice double kar di. Woh reject hone ke baad history ka sabse greatest player bana.

[pause]

Yeh farak dekhiye. Do log same situation mein hote hain. Ek quit kar deta hai kyunki usse lagta hai talent fix hai. Doosra grow karta hai kyunki usse pata hai effort se sab kuch badal sakta hai.

[serious] Business mein bhi yehi pattern chalta hai. Dweck ne companies study ki. Jin leaders mein fixed mindset tha, woh apne aap ko genius maante the. Woh feedback accept nahi karte the. Woh apni team ke mistakes ko chhupate the, kyunki mistake unke liye weakness ka symbol thi.

Lekin jin leaders mein growth mindset tha, woh apni company mein ek culture banate the jahan learning ko celebrate kiya jaata tha. Failure ko punish nahi, discuss kiya jaata tha. Aur yeh companies long term mein zyada innovative, zyada successful ban gayi.

[instructive] Relationships mein bhi same principle chalta hai. Fixed mindset wale log sochte hain — "Agar humara rishta mushkil mein hai, toh iska matlab hum compatible nahi hain." Growth mindset wale log sochte hain — "Har rishta kaam maangta hai. Problems normal hain. Unhe solve karna hi rishta ban'na hai."

[pause] Dekha aapne? Yeh mindset sirf ek exam ya ek job tak seemit nahi hai. Yeh puri zindagi jeene ka tareeka hai.

[authoritative] Ab yahan ek important cheez clear karni hai. Dweck yeh nahi kehti ki growth mindset wale log hamesha positive rehte hain, ya unhe kabhi bura nahi lagta. Growth mindset ka matlab yeh nahi ki failure paining nahi hoti.

Farak yeh hai — growth mindset wala insaan pain ko permanent nahi maanta. Woh maanta hai ki yeh phase hai, aur agla step improve karne ka hai.

[reflective] Aur yahan ek aur deep baat hai — hum mein se koi bhi purely fixed ya purely growth mindset mein nahi hota. Har insaan ke andar dono exist karte hain, alag-alag areas mein. Shayad aap apne career mein growth mindset rakhte hain, lekin apne looks ya apni relationships ke baare mein fixed soch rakhte hain.

[instructive] Toh sawaal yeh nahi hai ki aap kaun se category mein hain. Sawaal yeh hai — aap consciously kaunsa mindset choose kar rahe hain, har situation mein.

[serious] Dweck kehti hain, mindset badalna ek din ka kaam nahi hai. Yeh ek practice hai. Jab bhi aapko lage ki aap fixed mindset ki taraf ja rahe hain — jab aap kisi challenge se bhaag rahe hain, jab aap feedback se dar rahe hain, jab aap kisi mistake ko apni identity bana rahe hain — tab ruko. Aur khud se poochho — "Kya main is situation ko seekhne ke opportunity ki tarah dekh sakta hoon?"

[pause]

Yeh ek simple shift hai. Lekin yehi shift, baar baar practice karne se, ek nayi personality bana deta hai.

[measured] Toh chaliye is poori baat ko samet te hain.

Fixed mindset kehta hai — ability fix hai, mistakes threat hain, challenge se bachna hi safety hai.

Growth mindset kehta hai — ability develop ho sakti hai, mistakes teacher hain, challenge hi growth ka rasta hai.

Aur research clearly dikhati hai — jo log growth mindset apnate hain, woh long term mein zyada resilient bante hain, zyada achieve karte hain, aur zyada satisfied life jeete hain.

[reflective] Toh agli baar jab koi mushkil task saamne aaye. Jab koi failure lage. Jab koi criticism sunayi de.

[serious] Ek moment ruko. Aur decide karo — kya main is moment ko apni limit maan raha hoon? Ya main isse apna agla step bana raha hoon?

[authoritative] Yehi Carol Dweck ka sabse bada sabak hai. Aapka talent nahi, aapka mindset decide karta hai ki aap kahan tak jaayenge.

[pause]

[serious] Potential koi fixed number nahi hai. Potential ek process hai. Aur woh process, sirf ek cheez se shuru hota hai — belief ki, aap grow kar sakte hain.
